Run the value checks for every variable

Source: R/value-checks.R
run_value_checks.Rd

Run the value checks for every variable

Usage

run_value_checks(concordance, ev)

Arguments

concordance

Concordance in the v1 layout (or the v1 PF concordance).

ev

Evidence from load_evidence().

Value

A data.table: variable_name, report_type, then the columns of value_checks().
